name: Lanternbearer's Splint
summary: Splint armor that glows when you will it, like a lantern.
description: Patrols on the long road wear it so their comrades can find them in the dark. The plates are the dull gold of old brass.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. As a Bonus Action, you can cause it to shed Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet, or end the light.
